# clawee

> A fast, resumable remote-shell client: persistent PTY sessions on your machines, attached from anywhere over the burrowee transport.

clawee has two components: the **clawee** client (your laptop/workstation) and the **claweed** daemon (the session broker on boxes that host sessions). It requires burrowee and a paired gateway — clawee owns no transport of its own. Install with `curl -fsSL https://release.clawee.org/clawee/install.sh | sh`; installers are fetched over TLS, signed, and minisign-verified before anything runs.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://clawee.org/docs): hub — overview and links to every page below
- [Quick start](https://clawee.org/docs/quickstart): fresh machine to a running session — requirements, install, pair a device, attach
- [Sessions & keys](https://clawee.org/docs/sessions): attach flags, the session picker, views & keys, locking, the composer, slash commands
- [Gateways & users](https://clawee.org/docs/gateways): the multi-user gateway model, the tree chooser, the gateway verbs
- [Relays](https://clawee.org/docs/relays): relay preference order, LAN auto-rank, the relays verbs
- [Devices & pairing](https://clawee.org/docs/devices): the device trust model, knock/approve, revocation
- [The daemon](https://clawee.org/docs/daemon): claweed operations — setup, doctor, update, service unit, tenants
- [Full docs as plain text](https://clawee.org/llms-full.txt): the complete reference in one markdown file
- [clawee CLI reference](https://clawee.org/docs/clawee): every clawee subcommand, generated verbatim from the binary's own help renderer — raw markdown: [cli-help.md](https://clawee.org/docs/clawee/cli-help.md) (best for agents)
- [claweed CLI reference](https://clawee.org/docs/claweed): every claweed subcommand, generated verbatim from the binary's own help renderer — raw markdown: [cli-help.md](https://clawee.org/docs/claweed/cli-help.md) (best for agents)

## Install

- Client: `curl -fsSL https://release.clawee.org/clawee/install.sh | sh`
- Daemon (session hosts): `curl -fsSL https://release.clawee.org/claweed/install.sh | sh`

## Related

- [burrowee](https://burrowee.com): the transport clawee runs on — pairing, gateways, relays, the encrypted tunnel
